links.outcome: Readability (Gunning Fog Index) of ChatGPT responses to erectile dysfunction patient questions
links.effect: Median Gunning Fog readability was 15.9 (epidemiology), 14.5 (treatment and prevention), 13.9 (risks of treatment), and 13.8 (counseling), above the average patient's reading level.
links.quote: ChatGPT provides accurate answers to common patient questions pertaining to ED, although its understanding of treatment options is incomplete and responses are at a reading level too advanced for the average patient.

links.outcome: Comprehensibility (reading level) of AI-generated patient education responses
links.effect: Median readability scores of 13.8 to 15.9 across question domains indicate responses are written at a level too advanced for the average patient.
links.quote: ChatGPT provides accurate answers to common patient questions pertaining to ED, although its understanding of treatment options is incomplete and responses are at a reading level too advanced for the average patient.

links.outcome: Reproducibility of ChatGPT responses across repeated runs on two days
links.effect: Reproducibility was fair for epidemiology, poor for treatment and prevention, and good for risks of treatment and counseling.
links.quote: There was poor reproducibility of responses with a median readability of 14.5 (IQR 4.0).

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's baseline accuracy, readability, and reproducibility for answering patient questions about erectile dysfunction without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
